packageRules.description: The engines block is a floor we choose, not a version we track. Renovate proposed ">=24.19.0" over ">=24.0.0" within minutes; the runner resolves node-version: 24 to whatever patch it has, so a patch-level floor fails yarn at "Validating package.json" before it fetches anything. What we actually run is tracked where it is real: the Dockerfile digest and .nvmrc.
Automatically ship backwards-compatible updates after CI passes.
Keep unrelated updates independently attributable and reversible.
